checks: The verifier checks the captured typed native success for the exact unit and invocation before root acceptance/exact-stop. It does not require the current fit to be stopped first, avoiding a circular gate; predecessor cache/profile stops remain bound inputs.

The full trainer CLI, source commit/167-file manifest, fit-only membership, accepted homogeneous cache provenance, and producer-recorded array hashes plus shape/dtype/stat identities are checked against pinned records without opening cache-array payloads.

Model and normalization tensors are checked for expected inventory, shape, finite FP32 values, and identity agreement across model.pt, model_ep3.pt, training state, and provenance. The checker binds the canonical normalization implementation and identity; it does not recompute normalization from dataset arrays.

The exact epoch-bound training-state schema, next_epoch=4, AdamW moments and step counts, OneCycle horizon/final learning rate, loader/RNG/auxiliary state, and history/provenance progress counters are checked; evaluation is required to remain withheld.

Checkpoint reads use O_NOFOLLOW, per-file and aggregate byte caps, SHA-256, weights_only=True restricted loading, and file identity/stability checks. No prediction-array or dataset-array read is part of the checker.
